caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, tan-colored ceramic jar with an open mouth and a slightly raised rim at the top. The surface of the jar features horizontal striations, indicating the method of formation, and some minor irregularities and speckles in texture. Around the upper portion of the jar, there is a section with a dark blue inscription, partially visible, that reads "PLUMBS." Directly beneath the word is a decorative blue flourish resembling a stylized floral or scroll motif that curves outward on both sides. The background of the drawing is a solid, light beige color, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition. The jar is centrally positioned and is the sole focus of the image.
title: Jar
